assumptions.feeding: eat share rises to about 0.30 (lognormal noise 0.2) during the hours in FEED_HOURS, other classes shrink in proportion
assumptions.window_noise: rest share x lognormal(0, 0.15), pigs seen + N(0, 0.2)
assumptions.lethargy: active share x 0.5 (moved to rest), motion x 0.5; gradual = linear ramp over 3 h
assumptions.distress: true negative share 0.15 -> 0.60, call rate x 1.5; gradual = ramp over 3 h
assumptions.camera_fault: pigs seen 0, shares replaced by noise
assumptions.feeder_failure: no feeding peak after onset (eat share stays at its non-feeding level)
assumptions.onset: uniform between 06:00 and 18:00, lasts to the end of the day
assumptions.baseline: median and 1.4826 x MAD per field and hour of day over 7 normal days, spread floors 0.02 (shares), 0.03 (negative share), 0.25 (pigs seen), 0.01 (eat)
